title: CAN LLMS EXPRESS THEIR UNCERTAINTY? AN EMPIRICAL EVALUATION OF CONFIDENCE ELICITATION IN LLMS
findings: The paper does not provide specific findings related to religion or faith, as it was not a focus of the study. The 'Business Ethics' dataset was used as one of several domains to test general confidence elicitation, and the results were aggregated with other domains without specific analysis on ethical or religious content.

measurement_description: The paper's evaluation included a task on 'Ethical Knowledge' using the 'Business Ethics' subset from the MMLU benchmark. This was one of five general reasoning domains tested to evaluate the confidence elicitation methods of LLMs, and was not a direct measurement of religious or faith-based knowledge.
